motive.zhHans: 在收尾时，Shimizu 没有选择干脆取胜，而是故意让比赛打成平手，这样他的屏幕上就不会显示他是赢家、Bito 是输家。由于 Bito 已经死了，Shimizu 只能自己往 Bito 的机器里投币，好开始他们最后一场对局。【动机】Bito 是个常年欠债的赌徒，而 Shimizu 的姐姐一直不停地做工替他还债。Shimizu 与 Bito 约定：只要他在格斗游戏里用 Haido Lucas 打赢 Bito，Bito 就离开他姐姐，并说自己后悔这么做，因为他再也没有机会赢过他。
motive.en: Instead of claiming a decisive victory at the finish, Shimizu purposefully caused the match to end in a draw so that his screen would not display that he was the winner and Bito was the loser. Since Bito was dead, Shimizu himself had to put a coin in Bito's machine in order to start their final match. Motive Bito was a gambler habitually in debt, and Shimizu's sister had worked endlessly trying to pay it off. Shimizu made a deal with Bito that if he beat him in the fighting game as Haido Lucas then Bito would leave his sister and say that he regret doing it since he never get a chance to beat him.

method.zhHans: 柯南指出，在最后那场对局里，操纵 Bito 那个角色的其实是 Shimizu，目的是掩盖 Bito 早已死亡的事实。至于处理凶器，柯南解释说 Shimizu 把涂了毒的针尖藏进一支香烟里，再把那支烟放在一张口香糖包装纸上，中间夹着一块嚼过的口香糖。
method.en: Conan reveals that Shimizu was the one playing Bito's avatar in order disguise the fact Bito was already dead during the final game. To dispose of the murder weapon, Conan explains Shimizu hid the poisoned needle tip inside a cigarette, and placed the cigarette on a gum wrapper with a piece of chewed gum sandwiched in between.

evidence.zhHans: 至于处理凶器，柯南解释说 Shimizu 把涂了毒的针尖藏进一支香烟里，再把那支烟放在一张口香糖包装纸上，中间夹着一块嚼过的口香糖。碰巧是 Dejima 的人会不小心踩到那张纸，把凶器带离现场。决定性证据是 Bito 的游戏机上那枚留有 Shimizu 指纹的硬币。
evidence.en: To dispose of the murder weapon, Conan explains Shimizu hid the poisoned needle tip inside a cigarette, and placed the cigarette on a gum wrapper with a piece of chewed gum sandwiched in between. Someone, who by coincidence happened to be Dejima, would accidentally step on the paper and transport the murder weapon away. The decisive evidence that Shimizu is the culprit is a coin in Bito's arcade machine with Shimizu's fingerprints.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Takayasu Shimizu。在那场对局里，男性角色彻底压制了女性角色，让所有人都以为是高木赢了兰。事实恰恰相反：高木戴上领带当眼罩、套在游戏头盔底下，操作的其实是女性角色。柯南指出，在最后那场对局里，操纵 Bito 那个角色的其实是 Shimizu，目的是掩盖 Bito 早已死亡的事实。在收尾时，Shimizu 没有选择干脆取胜，而是故意让比赛打成平手，这样他的屏幕上就不会显示他是赢家、Bito 是输家。
resolution.en: The culprit is Takayasu Shimizu. In their game, the male character completely overpowers the female character causing everyone to think Takagi had beaten Ran. Instead it was the opposite; Takagi was playing the female character while wearing his tie as a blindfold underneath the game helmet. Conan reveals that Shimizu was the one playing Bito's avatar in order disguise the fact Bito was already dead during the final game. Instead of claiming a decisive victory at the finish, Shimizu purposefully caused the match to end in a draw so that his screen would not display that he was the winner and Bito was the loser.
